Early boss kill order for a smooth experience:
Devourer(Mud barrow) > cold witch(Clearfell) > hut witch(Grelwood) > rust king(red vale)
If you're more experienced, feel free to skip devourer. Devourer gives an extra support gem around -2 minutes, it's quite valuable for players who struggle in act 1.

For campaign you're just looking for basic gear with life+resist, generally resist is more important. For rings/gloves, these are pretty good pieces to pickup flat damage to attacks, as it'll boost your damage a lot.

For weapon you just want the highest damage crossbow you can find, note attack speed doesn't matter because you're a cooldown based build. In redvale you should get a 
Tense Crossbow
, at lvl 10 you should pickup a 
Sturdy Crossbow
. At lvl 16 you want yo fully invest into a 
Varnished Crossbow
, meaning you'll regal or alch, use 2 artificer orbs and use 2 runes (iron or storm rune). Since you wont swap this crossbow out until lvl 33, you preferable want one with good rolls before fully investing into it. %phys crossbows offer the highest DPS.

For boots you're looking for movement speed, it's an extremely important stat, I would never use boots unless they have movement speed on them.

Body armour is generally the best piece to get defense from, high armour or armour/evasion hybrid is usually the goal, armour is generally really strong in campaign.

Flask: Remember to constantly upgrade your life/mana flask throughout campaign, you can always buy a new one at the vendor when you meet the lvl requirements for the next tier (lvl 10, 16, 23, 30, 40, 50 and 60).

Important: Save all Gemcutters Prism(GCP), these are mandatory for 
Flameblast
 swap at lvl 52.

You'll also need to Save a couple of skill gems/support gems for the swap at lvl 52, but this should be easy since you don't use that many skills.

Frequently asked qustions
Issues with oil grenade not igniting or not dealing damage
1) You cannot have flat fire damage or extra fire damage anywhere on your gear (the only exception is your staff).
2) Make sure your weapon swap is setup correctly. Flameblast on weapon set 1 and oil grenade on weapon set 2.
3) If you're doing a map with burning ground you have to takeout tornado from your cast on dodge and replace it with another spell (like frost bomb).
4) You have to press oil grenades into flameblast and your flameblast has to hit a target.
Keep in mind on bosses, you don't have 100% chance to ignite and it could take 2 flameblast. Higher damage/higher flammability magnitude does help with this.
5) You're getting ignited and it's overriding your ignite on oil grenade, make sure to always use a 
Dousing Charm


6) 
Headhunter
 is not good for this build and the buffs it provides can brick your ignite.

-How do I get more skill slots?
With 
Unset Ring
s and 
Augmented Flesh
. You can snapshot skill slots. Put on your rings/amulet, equip your skills and than take them off. While you wont be able to use the skills, they will still count for stuff like 
Gem Studded
 and 
Essence of Virtue
.

To balance 
Gem Studded
, just make sure all the gems at the top are equal, but exclude gems in your staff skill as those do not count towards the total amount.

-Where do you get all of your gem quality from?
5% from 
Fox Idol

5% from 
Paragon
 Anoint
5% From Amulet suffix (desecrated modifier)
6% from gemling small ascendancy nodes
20-23% from Gem quality

This will give you in total 41-44% quality.

40% quality is pretty important as it's a breakpoint for some skills, 
Arctic Armour
 armour will gain 1 stage (and another +1 stage if you get gem lvl 27, for a total of 8). Quality is also a massive damage multiplier for 
Flameblast
.

 Swap, you'll want a decent staff (+fire skills), 30k~ gold to respec your passive tree and enough uncut skill/support gems.

Keep in mind there's no rush to swap, you can finish the campaign as grenades, if you didn't get any GCP or don't have a good weapon, than just stay as grenades for a bit longer.

Mandatory For swap to feel good:
one lvl 13 skill gem for 
Flameblast

Greater jeweller's orb for 
Flameblast

Lesser jeweller's orb for 
Oil Grenade
 (pretty plentiful, ideally a 2nd Greater would be nice)
Good weapon (+3 or +4 with inc spell damage or inc fire damage).
9~ uncut support gems for your new skills

Tornado
, 
Frost Bomb
 and 
Elemental Weakness

1 uncut spirit gem.
Make sure to properly setup your weapon set for 
Flameblast
 and 
Oil Grenade
 (flameblast on weapon set 1 and oil grenade on weapon set 2, and also follow the points correctly on the tree).

Do Not have Flat fire damage to attacks anywhere or it can brick your build. You can always check your oil grenade to see if it has any fire damage. (Extra fire damage is fine on the staff because you'll never have it out when using oil grenade).
